assertion_results.text: Each non-documentation, non-testing task file contains all required template sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, at least one of Files to Modify or Files to Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Documentation tasks (tasks whose filename or description indicates doc-only scope) and testing tasks (tasks whose filename or description indicates cross-cutting testing scope) are exempt from requiring Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes — they must still include Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements
assertion_results.evidence: Tasks 1-4 (task-1-severity-summary-service.md, task-2-advisory-summary-endpoint.md, task-3-cache-invalidation-on-ingestion.md, task-4-threshold-query-param.md) each contain ## Repository, ## Target Branch, ## Description, ## Files to Modify (tasks 1 and 2 also have ## Files to Create), ## Implementation Notes, ## Acceptance Criteria, ## Test Requirements. Doc task 5 and testing tasks 6/7 contain Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements, Dependencies.

assertion_results.text: Task count is between 3 and 12 inclusive
assertion_results.evidence: 7 task description files (task-1 through task-7); task-creation-log.md lists TASK-1..TASK-7.
The line under '## Repository' reads 'trustify-backend' in all 7 task files.

assertion_results.text: Task dependencies form a DAG with no circular dependencies
assertion_results.evidence: Dependencies: T1 none; T2->T1; T3->T2; T4->T2; T5,T6,T7->T1,T2,T3,T4. No task depends on a later or dependent task, so there are no cycles.

assertion_results.text: Every task's Files to Modify and Files to Create reference paths plausible within the repo-backend.md structure
assertion_results.evidence: Modified paths such as modules/fundamental/src/sbom/service/sbom.rs, sbom/endpoints/mod.rs, sbom/model/mod.rs, modules/ingestor/src/graph/advisory/mod.rs, graph/sbom/mod.rs, service/mod.rs, tests/api/sbom.rs, and tests/api/advisory.rs all exist in the manifest. The new files sbom/model/advisory_summary.rs and sbom/endpoints/advisory_summary.rs sit in existing directories and follow the model/+endpoints/ pattern.

assertion_results.text: Impact map lists concrete, specific changes (not vague or abstract descriptions)
assertion_results.evidence: The impact-map.md changes block is specific, e.g. 'Add GET /api/v2/sbom/{id}/advisory-summary endpoint, returning 404 for unknown SBOM IDs, cached for 5 minutes via existing cache infrastructure' and 'Add an SbomService method that counts unique advisories per severity ... using the existing sbom_advisory join table'. The repository analysis section also names specific files.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Repository section with a single repository name (not multiple repos per task)
assertion_results.evidence: Each of the 7 task files has '## Repository' followed by the single value 'trustify-backend'.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements sections as required by the handoff contract in task-description-template.md
assertion_results.evidence: Section headers in all 7 task files include ## Target Branch, ## Description, ## Acceptance Criteria, and ## Test Requirements. Tasks 5-7 were checked with grep; tasks 1-4 were checked by reading them.

assertion_results.text: File paths in Files to Modify and Files to Create reference paths from the repo-backend.md mock repository structure manifest, not invented paths
assertion_results.evidence: All Files to Modify entries exist in the manifest tree, e.g. modules/fundamental/src/sbom/endpoints/mod.rs, modules/ingestor/src/service/mod.rs, tests/api/advisory.rs. The two Files to Create entries are new files placed in manifest directories (modules/fundamental/src/sbom/model/ and sbom/endpoints/). No out-of-tree directories are invented.

assertion_results.text: Implementation Notes in every non-documentation, non-testing task reference specific file paths and code patterns from the repository, not abstract or generic guidance. Documentation tasks and testing tasks are exempt from this requirement as they intentionally omit Implementation Notes
assertion_results.evidence: Task 1 cites entity/src/sbom_advisory.rs, AdvisorySummary.severity in advisory/model/summary.rs, and AppError in common/src/error.rs. assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Target Branch section set to 'main'
assertion_results.evidence: The line under '## Target Branch' reads 'main' in all 7 task files.

assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:'
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-digest.md through task-7-digest.md each match the regex '^\[sdlc-workflow\] Description digest: sha256-md:[0-9a-f]{64}$' (7 of 7 match). Example: task-1-digest.md 'sha256-md:b84eacf5b7f4a0e150329789e9f41f00d4b13b5bacd91c9a1b81580a3ee4268b'.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: Every 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §...' line in tasks 1-4 is followed by a prescribed-format rationale, e.g. task-1: 'Applies: task modifies `modules/fundamental/src/sbom/service/sbom.rs` matching the convention's database query (`.rs`) scope.' and task-2: 'Applies: task modifies `tests/api/sbom.rs` matching the convention's `tests/api/` scope.' Each task includes only conventions that match its files (e.g. task 3 includes only Error handling and Testing, not Caching or Endpoint registration). The only 'Not applicable' text in the task files is in task-creation-log.md and refers to the bookend guard, not to a convention.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: The Feature priority is Major. impact-map.md additional_fields has '"priority": {"name": "Major"}' 'Applied to all 7 tasks'. task-creation-log.md says '`priority` is propagated because the Feature priority is `Major`, not "Undefined".'

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: The Feature fixVersion is RHTPA 1.5.0 and the scope is 'both'. impact-map.md has '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]'. task-creation-log.md says '`fixVersions` is propagated because the Feature has `RHTPA 1.5.0` and `fixVersion scope` is `both`.'

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md has the section '### Inherited fields propagated to tasks' with '**Priority:** `Major` — propagated to all tasks.' and '**fixVersion:** `RHTPA 1.5.0` — propagated to all tasks (`fixVersion scope: both`).'

assertion_results.evidence: task-5-docs-rest-api-reference.md headers are exactly: Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements, Dependencies. The Description states 'Doc impact type: Updates to existing content. Add the endpoint to the REST API reference.' None of the sections that should be omitted are present.

assertion_results.text: Testing tasks are generated from the testing readiness template — exactly 2 testing tasks are created (one per test category: Smoke Tests and Performance Benchmarks). assertion_results.evidence: There are exactly 2 testing tasks: task-6-smoke-tests.md and task-7-performance-benchmarks.md. Their Acceptance Criteria copy the template checklist items. In both files the headers are exactly Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements, Dependencies, with no omitted sections present.

assertion_results.evidence: The Dependencies section in task-6 and in task-7 lists Task 1, Task 2, Task 3 and Task 4 (all implementation tasks) and does not list Task 5 (documentation) or the other testing task. task-creation-log.md agrees: 'TASK-6 | TASK-1, TASK-2, TASK-3, TASK-4' and 'TASK-7 | TASK-1, TASK-2, TASK-3, TASK-4'.
